title: Process, instructions, and documentation-currency changes
summary: Repository-instruction files (README.md, AGENTS.md), the legacy top-level docs handbook, agent-platform contracts/policies, .claude agent definitions, everything under .github/ (workflows, and repo-governance config like dependabot.yml) and scripts/ci that supports process and documentation hygiene, and machine-readable security policy (security/) such as the Action-pin allowlist.

Scoped for PRs that update project instructions, agent definitions, documentation currency, or security/dependency policy, optionally alongside a small advisory CI mechanism -- not product UI, the contact route, or the orchestration domain.
risk: Low: no product UI, contact-form, or orchestration-domain runtime path is in this manifest's scope.
Any workflow or script change under .github or scripts/ci included here is still independently gated by this repo's action-pin and workflow-validation policy (npm run ci:workflows) where applicable.
testEvidence: npm run ci:quality and npm run ci:security pass for the candidate, same as any other PR.
npm run publication:scope -- --manifest agent-platform/publication/process-and-docs.json is run against the real candidate diff before publication.
documentationImpact: This manifest documents its own scope; it does not authorize bypassing any canonical .mdoc page.
A PR mixing in-scope and out-of-scope paths still fails publication-scope under this manifest.
rollback: Revert the PR through the protected pull-request workflow, same as any other candidate.
This manifest is independent of agent-platform/publication/phase-1.5-closure-hardening.json -- the two are unrelated, standalone records; reverting or editing one never affects the other.
